body:
Fuchs's Conjecture2.7 holds for every regular n-gon, n>=3, with first subsequent vertex stopping, sides, canonical parity-selected physical labels and source dihedral parallelism. The corrected proof distinguishes the intrinsic cone index from the physical folding-chart sign and uses hyperelliptic transport, classical Veech cusps and marked small-n lattices.

The September30 repository candidate and core proof route predate Ferudun's October9 equivalent theorem, DOI10.5281/zenodo.23267641, which is fully credited. The note describes contemporaneous separate developments with different proof routes; it does not certify mutual awareness, literal simultaneous release or first/exclusive priority, and does not backdate the corrected proof.

Three mathematical families and fresh whole-package adversaries examined the result. All corrections were propagated; the new final R5 passed without mathematical, lesser or optional findings. Exact controls19458 plus19 pentagon checks reproduce normally and with optimization, with meaningful failure controls. Finite checks support the universal geometric proof.

The Zenodo PDF/support archive and metadata are verified, the DOI resolves, and the tracker row 'Math Puzzles'!A61:D61 is read back with one DOI occurrence. All17 original attempt files are preserved exactly in the prepared native historical archive; the corrected native proof/source/code/package files await MAIN integration.
